summary: The platform successfully ingested the real NP-MRD andrographolide HSQC peak list, verified Modified Hungarian matching on real assignments, and reproduced all published SUMMIT v4 benchmark metrics from the per-compound fixture data.
provenance_mode: Hybrid (Mode D public archive cloud sync + Mode C narrow local fixtures)
commercial_use_note: Pro-tier commercial strategy pending resolution per ADR-0026.
benchmark_scope_note: REPRODUCTION, NOT INDEPENDENT VALIDATION (ADR-0036). The 92.3% top-1 figure reproduces SUMMIT v4's own outputs and carries no out-of-sample information. It must be quoted with the candidate-pool context: median 48 candidates, and accuracy by pool size of 79.3% (<10), 93.4% (10-50), 95.2% (50-200), 94.4% (>200). The 88.9% vs 44.3% site-localisation pairing is inflated: 15 of 36 compounds have at most two possible sites (8 have exactly one), so chance is weak on that subset. On the 21 compounds with more than two sites, top-1 localisation is 81.0%. See data/inventory/benchmark_context_report.md.
